reports.title: Bath & Body Works Reports Third Quarter Results Exceeding Guidance and Raises Full-Year Sales Outlook

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Based on third quarter performance and the company’s current outlook for the fourth quarter, the company is increasing its full-year 2026 net sales guidance to a decline between 3.4% and 2.1% compared to $7,291 million in fiscal 2025. The company is also updating full-year reported earnings per diluted share guidance to between $3.09 and $3.29, compared to $3.11 in fiscal 2025, and maintaining adjusted earnings per diluted share guidance of between $2.60 and $2.80, compared to $3.21 in fiscal 2025.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company is forecasting net sales to decline between 5.5% and 2.0% compared to $2,724 million in the fourth quarter of 2025. Fourth quarter 2026 earnings per diluted share is expected to be between $1.41 and $1.61, compared to earnings per diluted share of $1.99 and adjusted earnings per diluted share of $2.05 in the fourth quarter of 2025.
